name: sydney
description: Browser-based multiplayer melee FPS set in a geometrically accurate Greater Sydney

scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace client run typecheck && cd server && ../client/node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.world: cd pipeline && uv run python -m sydney build --stage inner
scripts.world:middle: cd pipeline && uv run python -m sydney build --stage middle
scripts.world:status: cd pipeline && uv run python -m sydney status
